from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Cash flow data extracted from one company's Form 10-Q for the period in question."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name from the 10-Q filing")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Period covered by the report, in YYYY-MM format")
    operating_cash_flow_direction: str | None = Field(description="Direction of operating cash flow: 'provided' or 'used'")
    operating_cash_flow_amount: float | None = Field(description="Operating cash flow amount as a positive number")
    operating_cash_flow_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of operating cash flow: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    investing_cash_flow_direction: str | None = Field(description="Direction of investing cash flow: 'provided' or 'used'")
    investing_cash_flow_amount: float | None = Field(description="Investing cash flow amount as a positive number")
    investing_cash_flow_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of investing cash flow: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the cash flow figures")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cash_flows: list[CompanyCashFlow]
